behavior_summary.collapse: Harmful 0x6F6F7A, uncurable, per-tick Slowness II and Weakness II, swimming pose lock, fall-flying stop, Stand held-input interruption, and Stand force-unsummon.
behavior_summary.luck_pluck: Diamond sword tool semantics, main-hand +7 attack, -2.4 attack speed, +0.5 block and entity interaction range, enchantability 22, GeckoLib idle model, and owner-keyed hand-free eligibility.
behavior_summary.mista_suit: Durability factor 16, defense 3/2/1, enchantability 15, projectile or revolver_bullet reduction of 15 percent per residual piece, overlay hiding, GeckoLib armor models.
behavior_summary.aja_stone_necklace: Vanilla head or Curios necklace equip, sneak use starts a charge from the server's item and block use events or, for a bare hand in the air, the server payload (sneak only starts it; no start while an item is in use; a use an entity interaction takes, or an item on cooldown, fires no use event and gets no keepalive, so it starts nothing); a use is taken from vanilla only while the server charges, on the client only once the clientbound charge-state payload confirms it and never for an entity interaction; a use pressed again within the 8-tick keepalive timeout goes on with the charge; the charge sound plays for the charger only; new-use PlayerPower held-input exclusion, Hamon gate, immediate Aja Stone Keeper fire or 50-tick light-gated charge, 40 damage, 36 range, 150-tick cooldown, GeckoLib armor and Curio render.
behavior_summary.spirit_cigarette: Next Album 0.1.13: stacks to 16; use lights it, held use inhales (4x burn), release after 8+ ticks gives 15 Focus ticks per inhaled tick and an exhale puff; Sneak+use holds up to five lit ones in the mouth (80 Focus ticks each per second, synced mouth count, head render layer); a lit one burns out in 2400 ticks. Focus (levels at 2400/6000 ticks, max 12000): Stand durability and precision x(1+0.1 level), stamina regen x(1+0.15 level) through StandStaminaModifiers; a Focus of 600+ ticks becomes Lax for the same time (x(1-0.1 level), regen not below 0.4). Advancements jotaro_trick and smoked_the_world.
behavior_summary.character_suits: Next Album 0.1.13 Pesci and Prosciutto suits (cloth/pants/shoes, CHARACTER_SUIT defense 6/5/2, enchantability 9, unbreakable, general_suit GeckoLib models, slim cloth variant, Stand-user recipes: Beach Boy for Pesci, The Grateful Dead for Prosciutto). Full Pesci set: the summoned Stand's damage, attack speed, durability, precision, interaction ranges and movement x(0.8 + 0.7 x Resolve ratio). Full Prosciutto set: right-click a worn piece in an inventory to cycle default / no coat / stealth; in stealth the player becomes a shadow after 200 ticks out of combat or at once when aged or in light 7 or less: name shown as Unknown, no name tag, drawn with the 0.1.13 shadow skin (slim or wide by the player's model type, first-person arms included), armor not drawn, footsteps silent and other player sounds at 30%, visibility x0.25, mobs drop it as a target (hostiles only beyond 8 blocks). Inherited Will and Glorious Death need the downed Resolve state (NA-4).
behavior_summary.onomatopoeia: Next Album 0.1.13: every footstep sound a Stand user hears shows one of the orange GO / DO / BA words near it (rising, wobbling, 18 ticks); client option onomatopoeiaParticlesEnabled (default on).
behavior_summary.resolve_aura: Next Album 0.1.13: a player under the core Resolve effect (or with resolveAuraOnSummon, with a summoned Stand) whose Stand is from Next Album (or any Stand with resolveAuraForAllStands) gives off aura flames in the Stand skin's colour: 7 a tick on the body (3 when only summoned), about 1.4 a tick on each first-person arm, 5 on the Stand (standResolveAura), 1 every 3 ticks on small Stands.
